The '''Galtea Binary system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]] region. The system's twin [[Star/Legends|suns]] emitted [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] fields that could mask a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from discovery by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' was [[Battle of Galtea|attacked]] in the nearby [[Galtea system/Legends|Galtea system]] by [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] loyal to former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] escaped to the binary system, where repairs were carried out on the starship. While in-system, the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew discovered that the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], who had been rendered [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] during the attack, had been covertly [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by a [[The Wraith|saboteur]] present aboard the ship. The corvette then traveled to the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]] in order to [[Mission to Sebiris|discover]] the source of the [[Sebiris poison|toxin]] afflicting Adrimetrum.

==Description==
The Galtea Binary system<ref name="EAOC" /> was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Traitor" /> located within the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], a region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Lying at several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours']] travel distance from the [[Galtea system/Legends|Galtea system]], it contained two unstable [[Star/Legends|suns]] that emitted [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] fields powerful enough to temporarily prevent a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from being discovered by [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] probing.<ref name="Traitor" />

==History==
When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Traitor" /> [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]]<ref name="DarkStryder">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> ''[[FarStar]]'' was [[Battle of Galtea|attacked]] in the [[Galtea/Legends|Galtea]] system by [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] loyal to<ref name="Traitor" /> former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]<ref name="DarkStryder" /> [[Kentor Sarne]]<ref name="Traitor" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' is set four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], thereby providing a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] for the [[DarkStryder Campaign]].</ref> the ''FarStar'' managed to escape the battle by [[Navigation computer/Legends|plotting]] a series of [[Precision hyperspace jump|micro-jumps]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] that eventually led the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] to the [[Scout/Legends|uncharted]] binary system.<ref name="Traitor" />

[[File:FarStar.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The New Republic corvette ''FarStar'' briefly hid from enemy forces in the Galtea Binary system.]]
Since [[Captain/Legends|Acting Captain]]<ref name="Traitor" /> [[Gorak Khzam]]<ref name="Traitor" /><ref name="DarkStryder" /> and [[Security officer/Legends|Security Officer]] [[Kl'aal]] agreed that the ''FarStar'' would be concealed from enemy sensor scans by the radiation from the twin suns, the corvette remained in-system while repairs were made to the ship. During the stay at the binary system, the ''FarStar''{{'s}} [[Medic/Legends|medical]] staff tended to [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], the ship's captain. Adrimetrum had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by [[the Wraith]], Sarne's undercover [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], during the attack near Galtea and had fallen [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] as a result.<ref name="Traitor" />

{{RPG}}
While Adrimetrum remained in her condition, the ship's crew proceeded to investigate evidence that pointed to the captain having been covertly poisoned by a [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] present aboard.<ref name="Traitor" />
{{Endgame}}

The former [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Breslin Drake]] then suggested the corvette [[Mission to Sebiris|investigate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]] in the nearby<ref name="Traitor" /> [[Sebiris system/Legends|Sebiris system]]<ref name="TEA" /> as a possible source for the [[Sebiris poison|toxin]] afflicting Adrimetrum. Acting on Drake's idea, the ''FarStar'' left the binary system for Sebiris.<ref name="Traitor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Galtea Binary system first appeared in "[[Traitor in our Midst]]," the sixth [[roleplaying game]] adventure in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a [[1995]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' boxed set. The adventure was written by [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and [[Paul Sudlow]]. The system went unidentified in its first appearance<ref name="Traitor" /> but was given a proper name by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square M-21.<ref name="TEA" />
